Title: Public Preview: Azure Database for MySQL Triggers for Azure Functions

Body.Content:
With the Azure Database for MySQL triggers for Azure Functions, you can enable change tracking and develop event-driven applications at scale on any MySQL table.  Azure Functions can be invoked when a row in a MySQL table is created, updated, or deleted through the Azure Database for MySQL triggers for Azure Functions.  

 

Learn more.
